title: Boston Logan to Woods Hole and Falmouth Private Car Service
includes: Complimentary 15-minute grace period for hotel and residential pickups
Boston Logan Airport pickup fees, when applicable
Standard luggage within the selected vehicle’s capacity
Complimentary airport wait time: 30 minutes for domestic and 60 minutes for international arrivals .
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels

Vehicles are not wheelchair-lift equipped. Foldable wheelchairs, compact mobility devices, and strollers may be accommodated when they fit safely in the selected vehicle’s cargo area. The passenger must be able to transfer into a standard vehicle seat. Please contact the office before booking to confirm equipment dimensions and available luggage space. Infant seats, toddler/convertible seats, and booster seats are not available but travelers may also bring their own child seat at no additional charge. Each child seat occupies one passenger seat and reduces the vehicle’s maximum passenger capacity by one.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Travel privately between Boston and the Woods Hole/Falmouth area in a clean, professionally chauffeured vehicle reserved exclusively for your group. Choose from a black sedan, SUV, or passenger van based on your group size and luggage needs.

For Logan Airport arrivals, we track your flight and provide clear instructions for meeting your chauffeur at the designated Limo Pickup Area. Tolls, airport fees, bottled water, and luggage assistance are included, helping make the trip straightforward from pickup to drop-off.

This service is especially convenient for travelers connecting with Martha’s Vineyard ferry service, while also serving hotels, residences, and other approved addresses within the designated pickup and drop-off zones. Communication may be available in English, Portuguese, or Spanish, subject to chauffeur availability.

Each reservation is private and covers one-way transportation only, allowing your group to travel without shared-ride stops or unnecessary detours.
